title: SAE Analysis Tools
summary: This module provides API endpoints for analyzing Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), allowing comparison of SAE activations between different system prompts and generating snapshots of SAE activations for specific messages.

nodes.label: Compare SAE Activations
nodes.title: SAE Comparison Endpoint
nodes.description: API endpoint to compare Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) activations between two different system prompts for a given message.

nodes.label: Snapshot SAE Activations
nodes.title: SAE Snapshot Endpoint
nodes.description: API endpoint to generate a snapshot of Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) activations for a specific system prompt and message.

nodes.label: Comparison Request Data
nodes.title: SAE Compare Request Schema

nodes.title: SAE Snapshot Request Schema
